figurative_meaning_bn: একার্থবোধক যুগ্মশব্দ; নানারকমের অন্তরায়; আপত্তি; মানা
figurative_meaning_en: Synonymous compound words; various kinds of hindrances; objections; prohibitions
example_sentences_in_bangla: প্রকল্পে বাধানিষেধ সত্ত্বেও কাজ চালিয়ে যান।
example_sentences_in_english: We won't heed any obstacles or prohibitions.
Despite the hindrances and objections, continue the project.
note: These are synonymous compound words commonly used in Bengali to denote various forms of interference or restriction.
